fiction_notice: Original fiction. Not a real event, person, company or recording.

hooks.text: Thirty-one people walked in. Nobody walked out.
hooks.note: Eight words and a complete mystery. The strongest raw hook line in the batch.

hooks.text: A year of doorbell footage and not one departure.
hooks.note: Same idea, stated analytically rather than as an image.

hooks.text: The camera records arrivals. It has never recorded a leaving.
hooks.note: Good rhythm, but a beat slower to comprehend.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 is a complete story in eight words: a number, an action, and an impossible absence. It needs no device knowledge, no setup, and no second sentence to become unsettling.
final_twist: There were never thirty-one visitors. Every arrival in a year of footage is her, and the camera is already recording the next one.
music_mood: Suburban quiet with a single low pulse tied to the doorbell chime, so the music and the device sound are the same thing. The pulse stops entirely at 0:32 and the last thirteen seconds have no music at all.
sound_bed: Doorbell chimes, key jingles, door latches, wind, and a deliberate absence of any footsteps walking away.
youtube_title: 31 People Entered This House. The Camera Never Saw One Leave.
